description: Unit tests for parsing and validating CT log response JSON structures, including SignedTreeHead and consistency proofs, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: ParsesValidJsonSTH
methods.description: Tests parsing of a valid Signed Tree Head JSON and verifies its fields.

methods.name: FailsToParseMissingFields
methods.description: Tests failure cases when required fields are missing in the JSON.

methods.name: FailsToParseIncorrectLengthRootHash
methods.description: Tests failure when the root hash length is incorrect.

methods.name: ParsesJsonSTHWithLargeTimestamp
methods.description: Tests parsing of a Signed Tree Head JSON with a large timestamp value.

methods.name: ParsesConsistencyProofSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests successful parsing of a consistency proof JSON.

methods.name: FailsOnInvalidProofJson
methods.description: Tests failure cases for invalid proof JSON inputs.

methods.name: ParsesProofJsonWithExtraFields
methods.description: Tests parsing of proof JSON with additional unrelated fields.
